title: JATT II Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: JATT II Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands-based special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), completed its initial public offering on April 20, 2026, selling 6,000,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 per share for gross proceeds of $60,000,000, with a 45-day over-allotment option for an additional 900,000 shares. Simultaneously, the company completed a private placement of 300,000 shares to its sponsor at $10.00 per share for $3,000,000 in gross proceeds.
key_points: JATT II Acquisition Corp. completed its IPO on April 20, 2026, selling 6,000,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 per share
Gross proceeds from the IPO totaled $60,000,000
Underwriters have a 45-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 900,000 additional shares at $10.00 per share
The company completed a private placement of 300,000 shares to sponsor JATT Ventures II L.P. at $10.00 per share, generating $3,000,000
The company is incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed on Nasdaq under ticker JATT
Four independent directors were appointed to the board on April 16, 2026
